g.text: RF-PID-301 REV B · ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD) · REV A SCREEN SHEET REMAINS THE OTS REFERENCE
DESUPERHEATED IN V-301 BY LIQUID C2= QUENCH TCV-316
LIQUID C2= 37.7 t/h TO LV-108 / E-102
QUENCH: HOLDS V-301 OUTLET NEAR SATURATION
CLASS: A3 CS 300# · L3 LTCS 300# (MDMT −46 °C) · S3 SS304L 300#
(MDMT −196 °C) · A1 CS 150# · CI COLD INSUL. · PP PERS. PROT.
h REF.: SATURATED LIQUID C2= AT −101 °C = 0 kJ/kg (E-203 BALANCE: RF-PID-201).
1. DESIGN BASIS: OTS MODEL DESIGN POINT, NOT PLANT DATA. ETHYLENE (Tc 9.2 °C) CANNOT CONDENSE ON CW: E-301 REMOVES ONLY THE SUPERHEAT, E-203 CONDENSES IT.
2. COLD SERVICE: WHOLE LOOP SS 304L (MDMT −196 °C) EXCEPT AS SHOWN; CI = COLD INSULATION. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY; CLASSES AND PSV-301 SET TBC.
3. TCV-316 SELF-ACTING QUENCH; IF IT FAILS THE SUCTION WARMS AND TSHH-307 TRIPS K-301. BLOCK VALVES FOR MAINTENANCE ONLY (LO IN SERVICE).
4. NON-CONDENSABLES (CH4, N2) COLLECT IN V-302 / E-203: CONDENSING PRESSURE RISES ABOVE Psat(TI-311). VENT BY HV-313 TO FLARE (LOSES C2=).
5. SETTLE-OUT WITH BOTH MACHINES STOPPED RISES TOWARD PSV-314 (24 BAR A) AS THE LOOP WARMS. FLARE HEADER MATERIAL FOR COLD RELIEF TBC.
A. PIC-301 → KT-301 SPEED (72–112 %): HOLDS SUCTION 1.139 BAR A (−101 °C IN E-102).
B. UIC-305 → FV-305 (FO): 10 % SURGE MARGIN ON FT-304. PIC-310 → LIC-213 SP (E-203 PROPYLENE LEVEL) HOLDS 17.8 BAR A.
C. START PERMISSIVES: K-201 RUNNING, TI-214 < −25 °C, FV-305 ≥ 90 %, PIC-301 MAN ≤ 5 %, LI-302 < 30 %, PI-310 < 14.5 BAR A.
RAISE LIC-213 TO ~75 % BEFORE STARTING: THE SETTLE-OUT VAPOUR MUST BE CONDENSED OR PSHH-306 TRIPS THE START.
D. REV B ADDS: SUCTION / DISCHARGE BLOCK, DISCHARGE CHECK, CW BLOCKS, QUENCH BLOCKS, DRAINS, VENTS, UCP-301, IS-301, LINE CLASSES.
